description: Defines the BaseEventDelegate class which manages event notifications, including registration, dispatching, and removal of notification emitters, with thread safety and integration with a worker pool.

classes.name: BaseEventDelegate
classes.description: Manages event notification registration, dispatching, and removal with thread safety.

classes.name: EventDelegateDispatchJob
classes.description: Inner class implementing a dispatch job for asynchronous event notification dispatch.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to handle incoming events, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event with payload asynchronously if registered.

methods.name: DispatchToAppNotifications
methods.description: Sends event notifications to registered emitters.

methods.name: AddNotification
methods.description: Registers a new notification emitter for a specific event.

methods.name: IsNotificationRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a notification for a specific event is registered.

methods.name: GetEmittersForNotification
methods.description: Retrieves all emitters registered for a specific event.

methods.name: RemoveNotification
methods.description: Removes a specific emitter from a notification or all emitters for an event.
